mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall. Tonight, we have a waxing crescent moon and an ISS flyover starting at 8:23 PM, rising in the West Northwest toward the Northeast and reaching halfway up the sky. The overnight low will drop to 60 degrees, and rain is in the forecast.
In city news, there are no new emails or articles to update you on at this time.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking into tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and live music at Paddy Mac's.

In a noteworthy update, officers handled a variety of calls over the last two weeks, including an incident on September 5 where they discovered several vehicles with cheese slices placed on their windshields as part of a social media prank.

The Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report. The store typically maintains hours until 10 PM, but please check back for updates on their reopening.
